label: Widget is visible
summary: Whether the given widget should be visible for this law.
details: It takes a widget. The succession law window passes `PdxGuiWidget.Self`, the widget it is used on, in a `visible` test. How the game decides is not documented.

label: The law entry itself
summary: The law entry itself, as a value that can be passed on.
details: No game file uses it on this type. Other types have a function of the same name that vanilla passes as an argument, for example `CHARACTER.Self`. Going by that and the name, it hands the object itself on; that is a hint only.

label: Select law
summary: Makes this law the selected one in the window.
details: The succession law window runs it from `onclick`. It returns nothing.

label: Needs vassal approval
summary: Whether changing to this succession law needs the approval of the ruler's powerful vassals.
details: Vanilla reaches it through the succession law window's selected law. When it is yes (and the government does not have the rule `deny_powerful_vassal`), the window shows the 'Powerful Vassal Approval' box: all powerful vassals must approve a change of any succession law. When it is no, the window shows the box for clan succession laws, which follow house unity instead.

label: The selected law
summary: The selected entry of the law group, as a value that can be passed on, going by its name.
details: No game file uses it. The explanation rests on the name.

label: The law group itself
summary: The law group itself, as a value that can be passed on.
details: The treasury budget change window passes it as an argument to `AccessSelectedLaw`, then asks the resulting law whether it is valid. It also passes it to `DecreaseBudgetGroupLaw` on a click and to get a law's short name as text.

label: Can-change tooltip
summary: A text explaining whether the law group can be changed.
details: The realm window uses it as `tooltip_when_disabled`, the tooltip shown while a control is disabled, so it explains why changing is not possible.

label: Current level
summary: The level of the law group that is currently in force.
details: The realm window chains `.GetLaw` onto it to get the law of that level.

label: The law group
summary: The law group this entry stands for.
details: A realm window text chains `.GetName` onto it to write 'Change <group name>'. The GUI also asks it whether it has a flag such as `realm_law`.

label: Laws of the group
summary: The laws that belong to the group.
details: The realm window uses it as a `datamodel`, the list it repeats rows over, one row per law.

label: Level by position
summary: The level of the law group at the given position.
details: It takes the position as a whole number. The realm window passes the row's own index in its list and chains `.GetLaw` onto the result.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The position of the level in the group.
fields.values: a whole number, for example PdxGuiWidget.GetIndexInDataModel

label: Next level
summary: The level that comes after the current one, going by its name.
details: No game file uses it. HasNextLevel is the matching check.

label: Previous level
summary: The level that comes before the current one, going by its name.
details: No game file uses it. HasPreviousLevel is the matching check.

label: Ruler
summary: The ruler (a character) that the law group belongs to, going by its name.
details: It is a promote, handing over a Character object. No game file uses it.

label: Has next level
summary: Whether a level follows the current one, going by its name.
details: No game file uses it on this type. The same name on another type appears in the value breakdown GUI; that is no evidence for this one.

label: Has previous level
summary: Whether a level comes before the current one, going by its name.
details: No game file uses it. The explanation rests on the name and the return type only.

label: Law group is available
summary: Whether the law group is available.
details: The realm window uses it together with a check for the group's `realm_law` flag in a `visible` test. What makes a group available is not stated.

label: New law available
summary: Whether something new is available in the law group, going by its name.
details: No game file uses it. The explanation rests on the name and the return type only.
